assertions.claim: Seven scam types memorized: order-rebate, fake investment, online loans, fake support, fake police/procuratorate/court, pig-butchering, seduction-with-tasks.
assertions.cn_span: 七类记住：刷单返利、虚假投资理财、网络贷款、冒充客服、冒充公检法、杀猪盘、色诱刷单

assertions.claim: Their one common point: they ask you to transfer money first, pay first, or share your screen.
assertions.cn_span: 共同点就一个——让你先转钱、先交费、共享屏幕

assertions.claim: A genuine loan requires no deposit fee or 'account warming'; if demanded it is certainly a scam.
assertions.cn_span: 真贷款不需要交保证金、做流水

assertions.claim: Police/procuratorate/court have no 'safe account'; anyone 'handling a case and taking statements' by phone or messenger is a fraudster.
assertions.cn_span: 公检法没有「安全账户」，凡是在电话、微信里办案做笔录的都是骗子

assertions.claim: A 'lover' seen only in photos and videos who constantly demands money for urgent needs cannot be trusted.
assertions.cn_span: 只见照片视频、从不见面却总有急事要钱的「恋人」不能信

assertions.claim: If money is already transferred — call 110 immediately to freeze the payment.
assertions.cn_span: 已经转了钱立刻打 110 止付

assertions.claim: Install the National Anti-Fraud Center app and always answer 96110 calls; RU adds a translator's clarification that Russia has no direct analogue.
assertions.cn_span: 装「国家反诈中心」App，96110 来电必接
